description: Front B (comprehensive catalog), O11 Reactive lane: port of the PLACEHOLDER part of tests/jobs-odc/block-reuse.json (proven in the ODC lane). The block CatBPriceTag declares an IPlaceholderWidget Footnote with EXAMPLE content; the block CatBPolicyCard instantiates it inside itself and fills the Footnote with an expression in the scope of the block itself; the screen CatBPolicySummary instantiates the CatBPolicyCard and also the CatBPriceTag directly, filling the Footnote with its note. Each instance has its own IPlaceholderContentWidget Footnote (the consumer of the placeholder). The job reads back the placeholder (get), its consumers (usages: one IPlaceholderContentWidget per instance) and the content of each instance (get/dump). Difference from ODC: in O11 the placeholder is a direct child of the block, because the reactive-ui creation map refuses IPlaceholderWidget inside IContainer; the copy of the example is not deleted by position, because the copy into the instance is only measured in ODC. Same scenario, independent results per lane.
